facts.fact: On 9 July 2026 the Ministry of Communication, Digital Economy and Innovation launched a national workshop, with WARDIP support, to draft Guinea's Telecommunications Policy, Strategy and Action Plan 2026-2030.
facts.system: Telecommunications Policy, Strategy and Action Plan 2026-2030

facts.fact: The policy, strategy and action plan being drafted cover the period 2026-2030, per AGP Guinee.
